Eyelids, brows, iris, nose and mouth must survive display at 128 x 160. One single character, complete feet and weapon, centered with 5% transparent padding, three-quarter front view facing slightly right, dynamic but calm battle-ready stance. Transparent background, no text, no labels, no ground, no shadow rectangle, no scenery. Character-specific face takes priority over a generic cute template.

Character-specific face and pose: Cheerful dark-skinned musician, large BLUE-TURQUOISE eyes, expressive lifted arched brows, broad warm open smile with tiny pale teeth. Short green hair and white flower.
Original appearance: Short green hair with braid crown, large white flower, warm brown skin, white-blue sari-like outfit, guitar.

Single face must remain readable at game size; honor the precise individual iris colors, eyelid shape, eyebrow angles and mouth expression above.
